verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly show that the 1Password browser extension can create, save and sign in with passkeys on websites. They also show that 1Password stores one-time passwords for two-step verification and lets you sign in without leaving the browser, though none of these items explicitly says TOTP codes are autofilled into login forms. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP autofill in the extension, independent or hands-on corroboration of TOTP and passkey autofill working in practice.
